labels.sentence: with the forward's final-norm state at the address block's width and two tokens' smoothed routing profiles in the free arm, no material margin (at or above +0.05) of the address block over the equal-dims free block and none of the address stream over the free arm is shown at horizon 2, 3 or 4, as at horizon 1 (R2): at this reader the address stream is not shown to add a material hit-rate margin over free information at any horizon 1..4 (lead time counted in forwards; no latency priced; NON-CRITERION; K-2 is untouched; K-6 stays UNTESTED and this is its lead-time datum); the stage-2 strike stands, PREFETCH-HEADROOM (which does not depend on this margin) stands, and OQ-9's prefetch half closes at this reader
labels.rule: readings SIGNAL iff CI95 lower > 0 and delta >= +0.05, NEGATIVE iff CI95 upper < 0, else NOT-SHOWN, at B=16, on the horizon's positions (t >= 1, t + j < length) pooled over the two coverage unions; PRECONDITION REPRODUCE: this read's horizon-1 rows for R2's nineteen arms equal the committed R2 state rows summed over their six strata into the two unions (hits-only mismatches on at most 0.1% of them within +-1 hit are NEAR; more, any needed mismatch, or a horizon-1 identity cell (D_eq^H, D_add^H, the anchor, free_h - free_r2 on all) that is not the R2 payload's to 1e-12 is INVALID = void, numbers only); per horizon the free arm's k and lambda selected jointly on that horizon's val positions (strict >, smaller k then smaller lambda on ties), every other arm's lambda on val at that k, the horizon-1 selections taken from the R2 payload; per horizon j in [2, 3, 4] on all positions: H-SURVIVES iff history_bigram_r2 - free_h and history_all_h - free_h both SIGNAL, H-COMPLEMENTARY iff only the union, H-ABSORBS iff neither, H-INCONSISTENT iff only the equal-dims (cause reader iff the anchor's CI95 upper < 0, floor straddle iff a CI95 contains +0.05, else neither); STAGE: LEAD-TIME-SURVIVES@j iff some horizon reads H-SURVIVES (j the smallest), else LEAD-TIME-COMPLEMENTARY@j iff some reads H-COMPLEMENTARY, else LEAD-TIME-ABSORBED iff every horizon reads H-ABSORBS, else LEAD-TIME-INCONSISTENT; a CI95 containing +0.05 is a floor straddle, flagged, and a straddle at a label horizon selects that horizon's not-settled sentence (at the first horizon of a SURVIVES / COMPLEMENTARY label, or under ABSORBED at any, the stage's closing claim is withheld; a later clean horizon does not rescue it); READER GUARD per horizon: where free_h - free_r2 or history_all_h - history_bigram_r2 on all reads NEGATIVE the horizon's label stays but its branch sentence is replaced (at the first horizon, or under ABSORBED at any, the closing claim is withheld); FREE-ARM EDGE: where free_h's selected lambda sits at an end of the grid at the first SURVIVES / COMPLEMENTARY horizon the closing claim is withheld, elsewhere it is said in words; a NEGATIVE D_eq^H and a NEGATIVE D_add^H each carry their own prefix; a fallback-scope SIGNAL on a label cell is said in words; the primary harvest's label is the label; the cross-harvest conditions (the closure line, the OQ-9 line) are executed at landing by the registration's text; NON-CRITERION, two pinned consequences (a dated STATUS line under F-26 and a dated K-6 STATUS line); no label reinstates stage 2 and no further rung is registered at any horizon
